Each luminous accent positioned through painstaking calibration.
The product of deep expertise and master-level execution.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os
import math

# === PATHS ===
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

W, H = 2400, 3400

CARD_BG     = (12, 18, 34)

ROW_ALT     = (10, 15, 28)
RULE_COLOR  = (30, 42, 68)
DEEP_RULE   = (22, 32, 52)

LANG_COLORS = {
    "Python":     (0, 195, 255),
    "TypeScript": (55, 135, 255),
    "Rust":       (255, 175, 65),
    "JavaScript": (225, 205, 65),
    "Dart":       (75, 195, 255),
    "HTML":       (215, 95, 75),
    "Verilog":    (165, 125, 250),
    "Shell":      (125, 185, 85),
    "—":          (72, 85, 112),
}

# === FONTS ===
def lf(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

f_title       = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 94)
f_subtitle    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_method      = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_section     = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_section_sub = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_huge_pct    = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 150)
f_pct_sub     = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_pct_label   = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_card_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 50)
f_card_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_thead       = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 20)
f_tdata       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_trepo       = lf("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)

f_rank        = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_rank_top    = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_bar_label   = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_bar_val     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_theme_title = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_theme_body  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_small       = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_tiny        = lf("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 16)
f_pill_val    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_pill_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 16)

# === DATA ===
repos = [
    (1,  "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills","—",         826, 79,  0,  0,  True),
    (2,  "NousResearch/hermes-agent",          "Python",    468, 102, 66, 61, True),
    (3,  "NawfalMotii79/PLFM_RADAR",           "Verilog",   353, 81,  5,  0,  False),
    (4,  "thedotmack/claude-mem",              "TypeScript",335, 33,  4,  0,  True),
    (5,  "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",        "HTML",      321, 49,  0,  0,  True),
    (6,  "JuliusBrussee/caveman",              "Python",    237, 19,  0,  3,  True),
    (7,  "multica-ai/multica",                 "TypeScript",139, 13, 44, 10, True),
    (8,  "safishamsi/graphify",                "Python",    120, 13,  0,  1,  True),
    (9,  "jamiepine/voicebox",                 "TypeScript",100, 12,  8,  3,  True),
    (10, "lsdefine/GenericAgent",              "Python",    101, 9,   5,  2,  True),
    (11, "rohitg00/ai-eng-from-scratch",       "Python",    82,  19,  0,  0,  True),
    (12, "EvoMap/evolver",                     "JavaScript",95,  5,   1,  1,  False),
    (13, "google/magika",                      "Python",    122, 7,   0,  3,  True),

themes = [

]

# === HELPERS ===
def txt(d, x, y, text, font, fill, anchor="la"):

def hrule(d, y, x0, x1, color=RULE_COLOR, width=1):
    d.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rrect(d, bbox, r, fill, outline=None, width=1):
    d.rounded_rectangle(bbox, radius=r, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

# === ATMOSPHERIC BACKGROUND ===
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_BASE)

# Layered radial glows for atmospheric depth
# Top-center glow — subtle teal-navy atmosphere
glow_layer = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))
gd = ImageDraw.Draw(glow_layer)
for radius in range(900, 0, -3):
    v = max(0, min(10, int(10 * (1 - radius / 900))))
    c = (3 + v, 6 + v * 2, 18 + v * 3)
    gd.ellipse([W//2 - radius, 100 - radius//3, W//2 + radius, 100 + radius//3], fill=c)
img = Image.blend(img, glow_layer, 0.25)

# Secondary subtle glow — mid-right, warmer
glow2 = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))
gd2 = ImageDraw.Draw(glow2)
for radius in range(400, 0, -3):
    v = max(0, min(6, int(6 * (1 - radius / 400))))
    c = (6 + v * 2, 4 + v, 8 + v)
    gd2.ellipse([W - 200 - radius, 800 - radius//2, W - 200 + radius, 800 + radius//2], fill=c)
img = Image.blend(img, glow2, 0.15)

draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# === LAYOUT ===
ML = 115
MR = 115
CW = W - ML - MR
y = 0

# ========================================
# HEADER
# ========================================
y = 95

# Signal markers — three thin dashes, precise spacing
draw.line([(ML, y), (ML + 90, y)], fill=CYAN, width=2)
draw.line([(ML + 100, y), (ML + 140, y)], fill=GREEN, width=2)
draw.line([(ML + 150, y), (ML + 170, y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
y += 28

# Title
txt(draw, ML, y, "GITHUB'S HOTTEST REPOS", f_title, WHITE)
y += 108

# Subtitle
txt(draw, ML, y, "AI Agents Dominate the Trending Charts", f_subtitle, CYAN)
y += 40

# Method line — separated by dim dots
parts = ["OSSInsight", "10.6B+ GitHub Events Tracked", "Score = Stars + Forks + Base"]
px = ML
for i, part in enumerate(parts):
    txt(draw, px, y, part, f_method, LIGHT if i == 0 else MID)
    px += draw.textlength(part, font=f_method)
    if i < len(parts) - 1:
        txt(draw, px + 8, y, "·", f_method, DIM)
        px += draw.textlength("·", font=f_method) + 16
y += 32

# Signature rule — accent segments
hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)
draw.rectangle((ML, y - 1, ML + 55, y + 1), fill=CYAN)
draw.rectangle((ML + 60, y - 1, ML + 105, y + 1), fill=GREEN)
y += 28

# ========================================
# HERO: 70% AI DOMINANCE — The Headline Insight
# ========================================
hero_h = 195
hero_y = y

# Card background with subtle depth
rrect(draw, (ML, hero_y, W - MR, hero_y + hero_h), 10, CARD_BG)

# Inner border — very subtle
rrect(draw, (ML + 1, hero_y + 1, W - MR - 1, hero_y + hero_h - 1), 10, outline=NEAR_FAINT, width=1)

# LEFT: The massive percentage — the visual anchor
pct_x = ML + 50
txt(draw, pct_x, hero_y + 8, "70%", f_huge_pct, GREEN)

# Subtitle beneath the number
txt(draw, pct_x, hero_y + 164, "of trending repos are AI/agent-related", f_pct_label, LIGHT)

# VERTICAL DIVIDER — hairline
div_x = ML + 530

# RIGHT: Three supporting metrics — precise grid
rm_x = div_x + 36
rm_gap = 28
rm_w = (W - MR - rm_x - 10) // 3

right_metrics = [
    ("14/20", "AI Repos in Top 20", GREEN),
    ("10.6B+", "Events Tracked", CYAN),
    ("826", "Top Stars (24h)", AMBER),
]

for i, (val, label, color) in enumerate(right_metrics):
    mx = rm_x + i * (rm_w + rm_gap)
    # Small top accent tick
    draw.rectangle((mx, hero_y + 28, mx + 28, hero_y + 31), fill=color)
    # Metric value
    txt(draw, mx, hero_y + 44, val, f_card_num, WHITE)
    # Label
    txt(draw, mx, hero_y + 102, label, f_card_label, MID)

# Bottom accent — proportional bar (70% green, 30% faint)
bar_70 = int(CW * 0.70)
draw.rectangle((ML + 1, hero_y + hero_h - 4, ML + bar_70, hero_y + hero_h - 1), fill=GREEN)
draw.rectangle((ML + bar_70 + 3, hero_y + hero_h - 4, W - MR - 1, hero_y + hero_h - 1), fill=NEAR_FAINT)

y = hero_y + hero_h + 32

# ========================================
# TABLE: TOP 20 TRENDING REPOS
# ========================================
txt(draw, ML, y, "TOP 20 TRENDING REPOSITORIES", f_section, WHITE)
y += 40

# Inline legend
lx = ML
draw.ellipse((lx, y + 5, lx + 10, y + 15), fill=GREEN)
txt(draw, lx + 16, y, "AI / Agent Related", f_section_sub, LIGHT)
lx += 175
draw.ellipse((lx, y + 5, lx + 10, y + 15), fill=DIM)
txt(draw, lx + 16, y, "Other", f_section_sub, DIM)
lx += 80
txt(draw, lx, y, "·  Past 24 Hours  ·  Composite Score Ranking", f_section_sub, DIM)
y += 30

hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)
y += 10

# Column positions — calibrated to content
c_rank  = ML + 10
c_repo  = ML + 68
c_lang  = ML + 750
c_stars = ML + 960
c_forks = ML + 1160

c_prs   = ML + 1500

# Table header
for cx, ht in [(c_rank,"#"),(c_repo,"REPOSITORY"),(c_lang,"LANG"),
               (c_stars,"★ STARS"),(c_forks,"FORKS"),(c_push,"PUSH"),(c_prs,"PRs")]:
    txt(draw, cx, y, ht, f_thead, DIM)
y += 26
hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, FAINT, 1)

# Table rows
ROW_H = 56
for rank, repo, lang, stars, forks, pushes, prs, is_ai in repos:

    # Alternating rows — very subtle

                repo_d = repo_d[:37] + "…"

    rf = f_trepo_b if is_ai else f_trepo

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Signal Noir — GitHub's Hottest Repos: AI Agents Dominate
FINAL PASS — Meticulous refinement. Museum-quality craftsmanship.

Every element placed with the precision of a cartographer mapping unseen constellations.
Each luminous accent positioned through painstaking calibration.
The product of deep expertise and master-level execution.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os
import math

# === PATHS ===
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# === CANVAS ===
W, H = 2400, 3400
BG_BASE = (8, 11, 22)

# === SIGNAL NOIR PALETTE — refined ===
CYAN        = (0, 195, 255)
CYAN_BRIGHT = (80, 220, 255)
GREEN       = (0, 240, 128)
GREEN_DEEP  = (0, 160, 90)
AMBER       = (255, 175, 65)
WHITE       = (248, 250, 255)
LIGHT       = (192, 204, 228)
MID         = (128, 142, 172)
DIM         = (72, 85, 112)
FAINT       = (38, 50, 75)
NEAR_FAINT  = (28, 38, 60)

CARD_BG     = (12, 18, 34)
CARD_BG2    = (16, 22, 40)
ROW_ALT     = (10, 15, 28)
RULE_COLOR  = (30, 42, 68)
DEEP_RULE   = (22, 32, 52)

LANG_COLORS = {
    "Python":     (0, 195, 255),
    "TypeScript": (55, 135, 255),
    "Rust":       (255, 175, 65),
    "JavaScript": (225, 205, 65),
    "Dart":       (75, 195, 255),
    "HTML":       (215, 95, 75),
    "Verilog":    (165, 125, 250),
    "Shell":      (125, 185, 85),
    "—":          (72, 85, 112),
}

# === FONTS ===
def lf(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

f_title       = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 94)
f_subtitle    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_method      = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_section     = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_section_sub = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_huge_pct    = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 150)
f_pct_sub     = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_pct_label   = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_card_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 50)
f_card_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_thead       = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 20)
f_tdata       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_trepo       = lf("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_trepo_b     = lf("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_rank        = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_rank_top    = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_bar_label   = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_bar_val     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_theme_title = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_theme_body  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_small       = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_tiny        = lf("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 16)
f_pill_val    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_pill_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 16)

# === DATA ===
repos = [
    (1,  "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills","—",         826, 79,  0,  0,  True),
    (2,  "NousResearch/hermes-agent",          "Python",    468, 102, 66, 61, True),
    (3,  "NawfalMotii79/PLFM_RADAR",           "Verilog",   353, 81,  5,  0,  False),
    (4,  "thedotmack/claude-mem",              "TypeScript",335, 33,  4,  0,  True),
    (5,  "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",        "HTML",      321, 49,  0,  0,  True),
    (6,  "JuliusBrussee/caveman",              "Python",    237, 19,  0,  3,  True),
    (7,  "multica-ai/multica",                 "TypeScript",139, 13, 44, 10, True),
    (8,  "safishamsi/graphify",                "Python",    120, 13,  0,  1,  True),
    (9,  "jamiepine/voicebox",                 "TypeScript",100, 12,  8,  3,  True),
    (10, "lsdefine/GenericAgent",              "Python",    101, 9,   5,  2,  True),
    (11, "rohitg00/ai-eng-from-scratch",       "Python",    82,  19,  0,  0,  True),
    (12, "EvoMap/evolver",                     "JavaScript",95,  5,   1,  1,  False),
    (13, "google/magika",                      "Python",    122, 7,   0,  3,  True),
    (14, "vercel-labs/open-agents",            "TypeScript",84,  12,  2,  12, True),
    (15, "thunderbird/thunderbolt",            "TypeScript",82,  4,   7,  0,  False),
    (16, "alchaincyf/nuwa-skill",              "Python",    67,  17,  0,  0,  True),
    (17, "BasedHardware/omi",                  "Dart",      111, 72,  9,  7,  False),
    (18, "farion1231/cc-switch",               "Rust",      77,  6,   5,  0,  False),
    (19, "S.Avogadro/android-re-skill",        "Shell",     77,  0,   0,  0,  False),
    (20, "rtk-ai/rtk",                         "Rust",      73,  4,   2,  1,  True),
]

lang_data = [
    ("Python",     7, 35, CYAN),
    ("TypeScript",  5, 25, (55, 135, 255)),
    ("Rust",        2, 10, AMBER),
    ("Others",      6, 30, DIM),
]

themes = [
    ("Autonomous Coding Agents", "AI writes code, handles issues, executes tasks", CYAN),
    ("Token Optimization",       "Slashing LLM token consumption by 60–90%", AMBER),
    ("Memory & Context Mgmt",    "Capturing, compressing, injecting session context", GREEN),
    ("Skill Distillation",       "Packaging expert mental models as reusable AI skills", CYAN_BRIGHT),
]

# === HELPERS ===
def txt(d, x, y, text, font, fill, anchor="la"):
    d.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def hrule(d, y, x0, x1, color=RULE_COLOR, width=1):
    d.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rrect(d, bbox, r, fill, outline=None, width=1):
    d.rounded_rectangle(bbox, radius=r, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

# === ATMOSPHERIC BACKGROUND ===
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_BASE)

# Layered radial glows for atmospheric depth
# Top-center glow — subtle teal-navy atmosphere
glow_layer = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))
gd = ImageDraw.Draw(glow_layer)
for radius in range(900, 0, -3):
    v = max(0, min(10, int(10 * (1 - radius / 900))))
    c = (3 + v, 6 + v * 2, 18 + v * 3)
    gd.ellipse([W//2 - radius, 100 - radius//3, W//2 + radius, 100 + radius//3], fill=c)
img = Image.blend(img, glow_layer, 0.25)

# Secondary subtle glow — mid-right, warmer
glow2 = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))
gd2 = ImageDraw.Draw(glow2)
for radius in range(400, 0, -3):
    v = max(0, min(6, int(6 * (1 - radius / 400))))
    c = (6 + v * 2, 4 + v, 8 + v)
    gd2.ellipse([W - 200 - radius, 800 - radius//2, W - 200 + radius, 800 + radius//2], fill=c)
img = Image.blend(img, glow2, 0.15)

draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# === LAYOUT ===
ML = 115
MR = 115
CW = W - ML - MR
y = 0

# ========================================
# HEADER
# ========================================
y = 95

# Signal markers — three thin dashes, precise spacing
draw.line([(ML, y), (ML + 90, y)], fill=CYAN, width=2)
draw.line([(ML + 100, y), (ML + 140, y)], fill=GREEN, width=2)
draw.line([(ML + 150, y), (ML + 170, y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
y += 28

# Title
txt(draw, ML, y, "GITHUB'S HOTTEST REPOS", f_title, WHITE)
y += 108

# Subtitle
txt(draw, ML, y, "AI Agents Dominate the Trending Charts", f_subtitle, CYAN)
y += 40

# Method line — separated by dim dots
parts = ["OSSInsight", "10.6B+ GitHub Events Tracked", "Score = Stars + Forks + Base"]
px = ML
for i, part in enumerate(parts):
    txt(draw, px, y, part, f_method, LIGHT if i == 0 else MID)
    px += draw.textlength(part, font=f_method)
    if i < len(parts) - 1:
        txt(draw, px + 8, y, "·", f_method, DIM)
        px += draw.textlength("·", font=f_method) + 16
y += 32

# Signature rule — accent segments
hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)
draw.rectangle((ML, y - 1, ML + 55, y + 1), fill=CYAN)
draw.rectangle((ML + 60, y - 1, ML + 105, y + 1), fill=GREEN)
y += 28

# ========================================
# HERO: 70% AI DOMINANCE — The Headline Insight
# ========================================
hero_h = 195
hero_y = y

# Card background with subtle depth
rrect(draw, (ML, hero_y, W - MR, hero_y + hero_h), 10, CARD_BG)

# Inner border — very subtle
rrect(draw, (ML + 1, hero_y + 1, W - MR - 1, hero_y + hero_h - 1), 10, outline=NEAR_FAINT, width=1)

# LEFT: The massive percentage — the visual anchor
pct_x = ML + 50
txt(draw, pct_x, hero_y + 8, "70%", f_huge_pct, GREEN)

# Subtitle beneath the number
txt(draw, pct_x, hero_y + 164, "of trending repos are AI/agent-related", f_pct_label, LIGHT)

# VERTICAL DIVIDER — hairline
div_x = ML + 530
draw.line([(div_x, hero_y + 24), (div_x, hero_y + hero_h - 24)], fill=FAINT, width=1)

# RIGHT: Three supporting metrics — precise grid
rm_x = div_x + 36
rm_gap = 28
rm_w = (W - MR - rm_x - 10) // 3

right_metrics = [
    ("14/20", "AI Repos in Top 20", GREEN),
    ("10.6B+", "Events Tracked", CYAN),
    ("826", "Top Stars (24h)", AMBER),
]

for i, (val, label, color) in enumerate(right_metrics):
    mx = rm_x + i * (rm_w + rm_gap)
    # Small top accent tick
    draw.rectangle((mx, hero_y + 28, mx + 28, hero_y + 31), fill=color)
    # Metric value
    txt(draw, mx, hero_y + 44, val, f_card_num, WHITE)
    # Label
    txt(draw, mx, hero_y + 102, label, f_card_label, MID)

# Bottom accent — proportional bar (70% green, 30% faint)
bar_70 = int(CW * 0.70)
draw.rectangle((ML + 1, hero_y + hero_h - 4, ML + bar_70, hero_y + hero_h - 1), fill=GREEN)
draw.rectangle((ML + bar_70 + 3, hero_y + hero_h - 4, W - MR - 1, hero_y + hero_h - 1), fill=NEAR_FAINT)

y = hero_y + hero_h + 32

# ========================================
# TABLE: TOP 20 TRENDING REPOS
# ========================================
txt(draw, ML, y, "TOP 20 TRENDING REPOSITORIES", f_section, WHITE)
y += 40

# Inline legend
lx = ML
draw.ellipse((lx, y + 5, lx + 10, y + 15), fill=GREEN)
txt(draw, lx + 16, y, "AI / Agent Related", f_section_sub, LIGHT)
lx += 175
draw.ellipse((lx, y + 5, lx + 10, y + 15), fill=DIM)
txt(draw, lx + 16, y, "Other", f_section_sub, DIM)
lx += 80
txt(draw, lx, y, "·  Past 24 Hours  ·  Composite Score Ranking", f_section_sub, DIM)
y += 30

hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)
y += 10

# Column positions — calibrated to content
c_rank  = ML + 10
c_repo  = ML + 68
c_lang  = ML + 750
c_stars = ML + 960
c_forks = ML + 1160
c_push  = ML + 1340
c_prs   = ML + 1500

# Table header
for cx, ht in [(c_rank,"#"),(c_repo,"REPOSITORY"),(c_lang,"LANG"),
               (c_stars,"★ STARS"),(c_forks,"FORKS"),(c_push,"PUSH"),(c_prs,"PRs")]:
    txt(draw, cx, y, ht, f_thead, DIM)
y += 26
hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, FAINT, 1)
y += 5

# Table rows
ROW_H = 56
for rank, repo, lang, stars, forks, pushes, prs, is_ai in repos:
    ry = y

    # Alternating rows — very subtle
    if rank % 2 == 0:
        draw.rectangle((ML, ry - 2, W - MR, ry + ROW_H - 8), fill=ROW_ALT)

    # Left accent bar — green for AI, faint for non-AI
    ac = GREEN if is_ai else NEAR_FAINT
    draw.rectangle((ML, ry + 3, ML + 3, ry + ROW_H - 9), fill=ac)

    # Rank — top 3 highlighted
    if rank <= 3:
        top_c = [AMBER, LIGHT, CYAN][rank - 1]
        txt(draw, c_rank, ry + 2, f"#{rank}", f_rank_top, top_c)
    else:
        txt(draw, c_rank, ry + 3, f"#{rank}", f_rank, MID if is_ai else DIM)

    # Repo name — smart truncation
    repo_d = repo
    if len(repo) > 38:
        parts = repo.split("/")
        if len(parts) == 2:
            owner, name = parts
            if len(owner) > 14:
                owner = owner[:13] + "…"
            repo_d = f"{owner}/{name}"
            if len(repo_d) > 38:
                repo_d = repo_d[:37] + "…"

    rf = f_trepo_b if is_ai else f_trepo
    rc = WHITE if is_ai else (100, 112, 138)
    txt(draw, c_repo, ry + 3, repo_d, rf, rc)

    # Language
    lc = LANG_COLORS.get(lang, DIM)
    if not is_ai and lang != "—":
        r, g, b = lc
        lc = (max(40, r//2+35), max(40, g//2+35), max(40, b//2+35))
    txt(draw, c_lang, ry + 3, lang, f_tdata, lc)

    # Stars
    txt(draw, c_stars, ry + 3, f"{stars:,}", f_tdata, WHITE if is_ai else (108, 118, 142))

    # Forks
    txt(draw, c_forks, ry + 3, f"{forks:,}", f_tdata, LIGHT if is_ai else DIM)

    # Pushes
    pc = GREEN if pushes > 10 else (LIGHT if is_ai and pushes > 0 else DIM)
    txt(draw, c_push, ry + 3, str(pushes), f_tdata, pc)

    # PRs
    prc = CYAN if prs > 5 else (LIGHT if is_ai and prs > 0 else DIM)
    txt(draw, c_prs, ry + 3, str(prs), f_tdata, prc)

    y += ROW_H

# Close table
hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)
y += 32

# ========================================
# BOTTOM: Two-column layout
# ========================================
half_w = (CW - 50) // 2
right_x = ML + half_w + 50

# ---- LEFT COLUMN ----
ly = y
txt(draw, ML, ly, "LANGUAGE DISTRIBUTION", f_section, WHITE)
ly += 42

bar_max = half_w - 190
for lang_name, count, pct, color in lang_data:
    bw = int(bar_max * (pct / 100.0))

    txt(draw, ML, ly + 1, lang_name, f_bar_label, LIGHT)

    bx = ML + 120
    # Track
    rrect(draw, (bx, ly + 2, bx + bar_max, ly + 24), 4, (18, 24, 44))
    # Fill
    if bw > 8:
        rrect(draw, (bx, ly + 2, bx + bw, ly + 24), 4, color)

    txt(draw, bx + bar_max + 12, ly + 1, f"{count} repos · {pct}%", f_bar_val, MID)
    ly += 38

ly += 14

# AI vs Non-AI bar
txt(draw, ML, ly, "CATEGORY SPLIT", f_section, WHITE)
ly += 40

ai_px = int(half_w * 0.70)
non_px = half_w - ai_px - 5

# AI segment
rrect(draw, (ML, ly, ML + ai_px, ly + 32), 4, (0, 55, 38))
draw.rectangle((ML, ly, ML + ai_px, ly + 2), fill=GREEN)
txt(draw, ML + 12, ly + 5, "AI / Agent  ·  14 repos  ·  70%", f_small, GREEN)

# Non-AI segment
rrect(draw, (ML + ai_px + 5, ly, ML + half_w, ly + 32), 4, (26, 30, 46))
txt(draw, ML + ai_px + 17, ly + 5, "Other  ·  6 repos", f_small, DIM)

ly += 48

# Stat pills
pills = [
    ("3,254", "Stars Across Top 10", AMBER),
    ("7", "Python Repos (Most)", CYAN),
]
px = ML
for val, label, color in pills:
    pw = 200
    rrect(draw, (px, ly, px + pw, ly + 40), 5, CARD_BG)
    draw.rectangle((px, ly, px + pw, ly + 2), fill=color)
    txt(draw, px + 10, ly + 5, val, f_pill_val, WHITE)
    txt(draw, px + 10, ly + 24, label, f_pill_label, MID)
    px += pw + 14

# ---- RIGHT COLUMN ----
ry = y
txt(draw, right_x, ry, "KEY THEMES", f_section, WHITE)
ry += 42

for title, body, color in themes:
    # Marker: small bar + dot
    draw.rectangle((right_x, ry + 5, right_x + 3, ry + 17), fill=color)
    draw.ellipse((right_x + 8, ry + 7, right_x + 17, ry + 16), fill=color)

    txt(draw, right_x + 24, ry, title, f_theme_title, color)
    txt(draw, right_x + 24, ry + 26, body, f_theme_body, MID)
    ry += 58

ry += 12
hrule(draw, ry, right_x, W - MR, FAINT, 1)
ry += 16

# Closing synthesis — the quiet final signal
synth = [
    ("The open-source community is racing to build", LIGHT),
    ("infrastructure for AI-augmented development.", LIGHT),
    ("Agent autonomy & efficiency are the twin priorities.", CYAN),
]
for text, color in synth:
    txt(draw, right_x, ry, text, f_theme_body, color)
    ry += 24

# ========================================
# FOOTER
# ========================================
fy = H - 55
hrule(draw, fy, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 1)
fy += 12
txt(draw, ML, fy, "Source: OSSInsight  ·  Data: Past 24 Hours  ·  Method: Stars Score + Forks Score + Base Score", f_tiny, DIM)
txt(draw, W - MR, fy, "SIGNAL NOIR", lf("Tektur-Medium.ttf", 14), NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")

# ========================================
# REFERENCE MARKS — Coordinate ticks, quiet precision
# ========================================
# Corner marks
cm = 18
draw.line([(W - MR, 85), (W - MR, 85 + cm)], fill=NEAR_FAINT, width=1)
draw.line([(W - MR - cm, 85), (W - MR, 85)], fill=NEAR_FAINT, width=1)

draw.line([(ML, H - 55 - cm), (ML, H - 55)], fill=NEAR_FAINT, width=1)
draw.line([(ML, H - 55), (ML + cm, H - 55)], fill=NEAR_FAINT, width=1)

# Side ticks — quiet measurement indicators
for ty in [500, 1100, 1900]:
    draw.line([(ML - 6, ty), (ML - 1, ty)], fill=NEAR_FAINT, width=1)
    draw.line([(W - MR + 1, ty), (W - MR + 6, ty)], fill=NEAR_FAINT, width=1)

# ========================================
# SAVE — final output
# ========================================
img.save(OUTPUT_PATH, "PNG", dpi=(300, 300))
print(f"Poster saved to {OUTPUT_PATH}")
print(f"Dimensions: {W}x{H}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Signal Noir — GitHub's Hottest Repos: AI Agents Dominate
FINAL PASS — Meticulous refinement. Museum-quality craftsmanship.

Every element placed with the precision of a cartographer mapping unseen constellations.
Each luminous accent positioned through painstaking calibration.
The product of deep expertise and master-level execution.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os
import math

# === PATHS ===
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# === CANVAS ===
W, H = 2400, 3400
BG_BASE = (8, 11, 22)

# === SIGNAL NOIR PALETTE — refined ===
CYAN        = (0, 195, 255)
CYAN_BRIGHT = (80, 220, 255)
GREEN       = (0, 240, 128)
GREEN_DEEP  = (0, 160, 90)
AMBER       = (255, 175, 65)
WHITE       = (248, 250, 255)
LIGHT       = (192, 204, 228)
MID         = (128, 142, 172)
DIM         = (72, 85, 112)
FAINT       = (38, 50, 75)
NEAR_FAINT  = (28, 38, 60)

CARD_BG     = (12, 18, 34)
CARD_BG2    = (16, 22, 40)
ROW_ALT     = (10, 15, 28)
RULE_COLOR  = (30, 42, 68)
DEEP_RULE   = (22, 32, 52)

LANG_COLORS = {
    "Python":     (0, 195, 255),
    "TypeScript": (55, 135, 255),
    "Rust":       (255, 175, 65),
    "JavaScript": (225, 205, 65),
    "Dart":       (75, 195, 255),
    "HTML":       (215, 95, 75),
    "Verilog":    (165, 125, 250),
    "Shell":      (125, 185, 85),
    "—":          (72, 85, 112),
}

# === FONTS ===
def lf(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

f_title       = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 94)
f_subtitle    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_method      = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_section     = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_section_sub = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_huge_pct    = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 150)
f_pct_sub     = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_pct_label   = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_card_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 50)
f_card_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_thead       = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 20)
f_tdata       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_trepo       = lf("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_trepo_b     = lf("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_rank        = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_rank_top    = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_bar_label   = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_bar_val     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_theme_title = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_theme_body  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_small       = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_tiny        = lf("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 16)
f_pill_val    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_pill_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 16)

# === DATA ===
repos = [
    (1,  "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills","—",         826, 79,  0,  0,  True),

"""
Signal Noir — GitHub's Hottest Repos: AI Agents Dominate
FINAL MUSEUM PASS — Every element painstakingly calibrated.

"A diagram from an imaginary discipline, treating the invisible subject
with the same reverence typically reserved for documenting observable phenomena."
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os
import math

# === PATHS ===
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# === CANVAS ===
W, H = 2400, 3400
BG_BASE = (8, 11, 22)

# === SIGNAL NOIR PALETTE — final calibrated ===
CYAN        = (0, 195, 255)

AMBER       = (255, 175, 65)
WHITE       = (248, 250, 255)

MID         = (125, 140, 170)
DIM         = (70, 82, 108)
FAINT       = (35, 46, 70)

CARD_BG     = (11, 17, 32)
ROW_ALT     = (10, 14, 27)
RULE_COLOR  = (28, 40, 65)
DEEP_RULE   = (20, 30, 50)

LANG_COLORS = {
    "Python":     (0, 195, 255),
    "TypeScript": (55, 135, 255),
    "Rust":       (255, 175, 65),
    "JavaScript": (222, 202, 62),
    "Dart":       (72, 190, 250),
    "HTML":       (212, 92, 72),
    "Verilog":    (160, 120, 245),
    "Shell":      (120, 180, 82),
    "—":          (70, 82, 108),
}

# === FONTS ===
def lf(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

f_title       = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 94)
f_subtitle    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_method      = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_section     = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_section_sub = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_huge_pct    = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 152)
f_pct_label   = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_card_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 48)
f_card_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_thead       = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 19)
f_tdata       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_trepo       = lf("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_trepo_b     = lf("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_rank        = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_rank_top    = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_bar_label   = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_bar_val     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_theme_title = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_theme_body  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_small       = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_tiny        = lf("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_pill_val    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_pill_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_ref         = lf("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 13)

# === DATA ===
repos = [
    (1,  "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills","—",         826, 79,  0,  0,  True),
    (2,  "NousResearch/hermes-agent",          "Python",    468, 102, 66, 61, True),
    (3,  "NawfalMotii79/PLFM_RADAR",           "Verilog",   353, 81,  5,  0,  False),
    (4,  "thedotmack/claude-mem",              "TypeScript",335, 33,  4,  0,  True),
    (5,  "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",        "HTML",      321, 49,  0,  0,  True),
    (6,  "JuliusBrussee/caveman",              "Python",    237, 19,  0,  3,  True),
    (7,  "multica-ai/multica",                 "TypeScript",139, 13, 44, 10, True),
    (8,  "safishamsi/graphify",                "Python",    120, 13,  0,  1,  True),
    (9,  "jamiepine/voicebox",                 "TypeScript",100, 12,  8,  3,  True),
    (10, "lsdefine/GenericAgent",              "Python",    101, 9,   5,  2,  True),
    (11, "rohitg00/ai-eng-from-scratch",       "Python",    82,  19,  0,  0,  True),
    (12, "EvoMap/evolver",                     "JavaScript",95,  5,   1,  1,  False),
    (13, "google/magika",                      "Python",    122, 7,   0,  3,  True),
    (14, "vercel-labs/open-agents",            "TypeScript",84,  12,  2,  12, True),
    (15, "thunderbird/thunderbolt",            "TypeScript",82,  4,   7,  0,  False),
    (16, "alchaincyf/nuwa-skill",              "Python",    67,  17,  0,  0,  True),
    (17, "BasedHardware/omi",                  "Dart",      111, 72,  9,  7,  False),
    (18, "farion1231/cc-switch",               "Rust",      77,  6,   5,  0,  False),
    (19, "S.Avogadro/android-re-skill",        "Shell",     77,  0,   0,  0,  False),
    (20, "rtk-ai/rtk",                         "Rust",      73,  4,   2,  1,  True),
]

lang_data = [
    ("Python",     7, 35, CYAN),
    ("TypeScript",  5, 25, (55, 135, 255)),
    ("Rust",        2, 10, AMBER),
    ("Others",      6, 30, DIM),
]

themes = [
    ("Autonomous Coding Agents", "AI writes code, handles issues, executes tasks", CYAN),
    ("Token Optimization",       "Slashing LLM token consumption by 60–90%", AMBER),
    ("Memory & Context Mgmt",    "Capturing, compressing, injecting session context", GREEN),
    ("Skill Distillation",       "Packaging expert mental models as reusable AI skills", CYAN_BRIGHT),
]

# === HELPERS ===
def txt(d, x, y, text, font, fill, anchor="la"):
    d.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def hrule(d, y, x0, x1, color=RULE_COLOR, width=1):
    d.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rrect(d, bbox, r, fill, outline=None, width=1):
    d.rounded_rectangle(bbox, radius=r, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

# ========================================
# ATMOSPHERIC BACKGROUND — Layered depth
# ========================================
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_BASE)

# Primary atmospheric glow — top center, cool teal-navy
glow = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))
gd = ImageDraw.Draw(glow)
for radius in range(950, 0, -4):
    v = max(0, min(9, int(9 * (1 - radius / 950))))
    c = (3 + v, 5 + v * 2, 16 + v * 3)
    gd.ellipse([W//2 - radius, 50 - radius//3, W//2 + radius, 50 + radius//3], fill=c)
img = Image.blend(img, glow, 0.22)

# Secondary glow — bottom-left, warmer
glow2 = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))
gd2 = ImageDraw.Draw(glow2)
for radius in range(500, 0, -4):
    v = max(0, min(5, int(5 * (1 - radius / 500))))
    c = (5 + v * 2, 4 + v, 8 + v)
    gd2.ellipse([200 - radius, H - 400 - radius//2, 200 + radius, H - 400 + radius//2], fill=c)
img = Image.blend(img, glow2, 0.12)

draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# === LAYOUT ===
ML = 115
MR = 115
CW = W - ML - MR
y = 0

# ========================================
# HEADER
# ========================================
y = 95

# Signal markers — three precise dashes
draw.line([(ML, y), (ML + 88, y)], fill=CYAN, width=2)
draw.line([(ML + 98, y), (ML + 136, y)], fill=GREEN, width=2)
draw.line([(ML + 146, y), (ML + 166, y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)

# Reference label — quiet, systematic
txt(draw, W - MR, y + 2, "REF.OSS-TREND-2024", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")
y += 28

# Title
txt(draw, ML, y, "GITHUB'S HOTTEST REPOS", f_title, WHITE)
y += 108

# Subtitle
txt(draw, ML, y, "AI Agents Dominate the Trending Charts", f_subtitle, CYAN)
y += 40

# Method line — precise, separated
m_parts = ["OSSInsight", "10.6B+ Events Tracked", "Score = Stars + Forks + Base"]
mpx = ML
for i, part in enumerate(m_parts):
    txt(draw, mpx, y, part, f_method, LIGHT if i == 0 else MID)
    mpx += int(draw.textlength(part, font=f_method))
    if i < len(m_parts) - 1:
        txt(draw, mpx + 8, y, "·", f_method, DIM)
        mpx += int(draw.textlength("·", font=f_method)) + 16
y += 32

# Signature rule with accent segments
hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)
draw.rectangle((ML, y - 1, ML + 52, y + 1), fill=CYAN)
draw.rectangle((ML + 57, y - 1, ML + 100, y + 1), fill=GREEN)
y += 28

# ========================================
# HERO: 70% — The Headline Signal
# ========================================
hero_h = 195
hero_y = y

# Card background
rrect(draw, (ML, hero_y, W - MR, hero_y + hero_h), 10, CARD_BG)

# Subtle inner border
rrect(draw, (ML + 1, hero_y + 1, W - MR - 1, hero_y + hero_h - 1), 10, None, NEAR_FAINT, 1)

# Vertical divider — hairline
div_x = ML + 530

rm_x = div_x + 36

right_metrics = [
    ("14/20", "AI Repos in Top 20", GREEN),
    ("10.6B+", "Events Tracked", CYAN),
    ("826", "Top Stars (24h)", AMBER),
]

for i, (val, label, color) in enumerate(right_metrics):
    mx = rm_x + i * (rm_w + rm_gap)
    # Accent tick
    draw.rectangle((mx, hero_y + 28, mx + 26, hero_y + 31), fill=color)

    txt(draw, mx, hero_y + 42, val, f_card_num, WHITE)
    # Label
    txt(draw, mx, hero_y + 98, label, f_card_label, MID)

# Proportional accent bar at bottom — 70% green, 30% faint
bar_70 = int(CW * 0.70)

draw.rectangle((ML + bar_70 + 3, hero_y + hero_h - 4, W - MR - 1, hero_y + hero_h - 1), fill=NEAR_FAINT)

y = hero_y + hero_h + 32

# ========================================

# ========================================
txt(draw, ML, y, "TOP 20 TRENDING REPOSITORIES", f_section, WHITE)
y += 40

# Inline legend

for rank, repo, lang, stars, forks, pushes, prs, is_ai in repos:

    # Rank
    if rank <= 3:

    else:
        txt(draw, c_rank, ry + 3, f"#{rank}", f_rank, MID if is_ai else DIM)

    # Repo name — smart truncation
    repo_d = repo
    if len(repo) > 38:
        parts = repo.split("/")
        if len(parts) == 2:
            owner, name = parts
            if len(owner) > 14:
                owner = owner[:13] + "…"
            repo_d = f"{owner}/{name}"
            if len(repo_d) > 38:
                repo_d = repo_d[:37] + "…"

    if not is_ai and lang != "—":
        r, g, b = lc
        lc = (max(38, r//2+32), max(38, g//2+32), max(38, b//2+32))
    txt(draw, c_lang, ry + 3, lang, f_tdata, lc)

    txt(draw, c_push, ry + 3, str(pushes), f_tdata, pc)

    txt(draw, c_prs, ry + 3, str(prs), f_tdata, prc)

    y += ROW_H

y += 32

    txt(draw, right_x + 24, ry + 26, body, f_theme_body, MID)
    ry += 58

    ry += 24

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os

f_pill_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_ref         = lf("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 13)

# === DATA ===
repos = [
    (1,  "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills","—",         826, 79,  0,  0,  True),
    (2,  "NousResearch/hermes-agent",          "Python",    468, 102, 66, 61, True),
    (3,  "NawfalMotii79/PLFM_RADAR",           "Verilog",   353, 81,  5,  0,  False),

    (5,  "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",        "HTML",      321, 49,  0,  0,  True),
    (6,  "JuliusBrussee/caveman",              "Python",    237, 19,  0,  3,  True),
    (7,  "multica-ai/multica",                 "TypeScript",139, 13, 44, 10, True),
    (8,  "safishamsi/graphify",                "Python",    120, 13,  0,  1,  True),
    (9,  "jamiepine/voicebox",                 "TypeScript",100, 12,  8,  3,  True),
    (10, "lsdefine/GenericAgent",              "Python",    101, 9,   5,  2,  True),
    (11, "rohitg00/ai-eng-from-scratch",       "Python",    82,  19,  0,  0,  True),
    (12, "EvoMap/evolver",                     "JavaScript",95,  5,   1,  1,  False),
    (13, "google/magika",                      "Python",    122, 7,   0,  3,  True),

    (16, "alchaincyf/nuwa-skill",              "Python",    67,  17,  0,  0,  True),

    (19, "S.Avogadro/android-re-skill",        "Shell",     77,  0,   0,  0,  False),
    (20, "rtk-ai/rtk",                         "Rust",      73,  4,   2,  1,  True),
]

lang_data = [
    ("Python",     7, 35, CYAN),
    ("TypeScript",  5, 25, (55, 135, 255)),
    ("Rust",        2, 10, AMBER),
    ("Others",      6, 30, DIM),
]

themes = [
    ("Autonomous Coding Agents", "AI writes code, handles issues, executes tasks", CYAN),
    ("Token Optimization",       "Slashing LLM token consumption by 60–90%", AMBER),
    ("Memory & Context Mgmt",    "Capturing, compressing, injecting session context", GREEN),
    ("Skill Distillation",       "Packaging expert mental models as reusable AI skills", CYAN_BRIGHT),
]

# === HELPERS ===
def txt(d, x, y, text, font, fill, anchor="la"):
    d.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def hrule(d, y, x0, x1, color=RULE_COLOR, width=1):
    d.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rrect(d, bbox, r, fill, outline=None, width=1):

# ========================================
# ATMOSPHERIC BACKGROUND — Layered depth

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_BASE)

# Primary atmospheric glow — top center, cool teal-navy

gd = ImageDraw.Draw(glow)
for radius in range(950, 0, -4):
    v = max(0, min(9, int(9 * (1 - radius / 950))))
    c = (3 + v, 5 + v * 2, 16 + v * 3)
    gd.ellipse([W//2 - radius, 50 - radius//3, W//2 + radius, 50 + radius//3], fill=c)
img = Image.blend(img, glow, 0.22)

# Secondary glow — bottom-left, warmer
glow2 = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))
gd2 = ImageDraw.Draw(glow2)
for radius in range(500, 0, -4):
    v = max(0, min(5, int(5 * (1 - radius / 500))))
    c = (5 + v * 2, 4 + v, 8 + v)
    gd2.ellipse([200 - radius, H - 400 - radius//2, 200 + radius, H - 400 + radius//2], fill=c)
img = Image.blend(img, glow2, 0.12)

draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# === LAYOUT ===
ML = 115
MR = 115
CW = W - ML - MR
y = 0

# ========================================
# HEADER
# ========================================
y = 95

# Signal markers — three precise dashes
draw.line([(ML, y), (ML + 88, y)], fill=CYAN, width=2)
draw.line([(ML + 98, y), (ML + 136, y)], fill=GREEN, width=2)
draw.line([(ML + 146, y), (ML + 166, y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)

# Reference label — quiet, systematic
txt(draw, W - MR, y + 2, "REF.OSS-TREND-2024", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")
y += 28

# Title
txt(draw, ML, y, "GITHUB'S HOTTEST REPOS", f_title, WHITE)
y += 108

# Subtitle
txt(draw, ML, y, "AI Agents Dominate the Trending Charts", f_subtitle, CYAN)
y += 40

# Method line — precise, separated
m_parts = ["OSSInsight", "10.6B+ Events Tracked", "Score = Stars + Forks + Base"]
mpx = ML
for i, part in enumerate(m_parts):
    txt(draw, mpx, y, part, f_method, LIGHT if i == 0 else MID)
    mpx += int(draw.textlength(part, font=f_method))
    if i < len(m_parts) - 1:
        txt(draw, mpx + 8, y, "·", f_method, DIM)
        mpx += int(draw.textlength("·", font=f_method)) + 16
y += 32

# Signature rule with accent segments
hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)
draw.rectangle((ML, y - 1, ML + 52, y + 1), fill=CYAN)
draw.rectangle((ML + 57, y - 1, ML + 100, y + 1), fill=GREEN)
y += 28

# ========================================
# HERO: 70% — The Headline Signal
# ========================================
hero_h = 195
hero_y = y

# Card background
rrect(draw, (ML, hero_y, W - MR, hero_y + hero_h), 10, CARD_BG)

# Subtle inner border
rrect(draw, (ML + 1, hero_y + 1, W - MR - 1, hero_y + hero_h - 1), 10, None, NEAR_FAINT, 1)

# LUMINOUS GLOW behind 70% — the signal piercing the darkness
# Create a separate glow layer
glow_img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))
glow_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(glow_img)
for r in range(200, 0, -2):
    v = max(0, min(14, int(14 * (1 - r / 200))))
    c = (0, v * 3, v * 2)
    glow_draw.ellipse([ML + 100 - r, hero_y + 95 - r//2, ML + 100 + r, hero_y + 95 + r//2], fill=c)
img = Image.blend(img, glow_img, 0.35)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# The percentage — monumental
txt(draw, ML + 50, hero_y + 6, "70%", f_huge_pct, GREEN)

# Label beneath
txt(draw, ML + 50, hero_y + 165, "of trending repos are AI/agent-related", f_pct_label, LIGHT)

# Vertical divider — hairline
div_x = ML + 530
draw.line([(div_x, hero_y + 24), (div_x, hero_y + hero_h - 24)], fill=FAINT, width=1)

# Right supporting metrics
rm_x = div_x + 36
rm_gap = 24
rm_w = (W - MR - rm_x - 10) // 3

right_metrics = [
    ("14/20", "AI Repos in Top 20", GREEN),
    ("10.6B+", "Events Tracked", CYAN),
    ("826", "Top Stars (24h)", AMBER),
]

for i, (val, label, color) in enumerate(right_metrics):
    mx = rm_x + i * (rm_w + rm_gap)
    # Accent tick
    draw.rectangle((mx, hero_y + 28, mx + 26, hero_y + 31), fill=color)
    # Value
    txt(draw, mx, hero_y + 42, val, f_card_num, WHITE)
    # Label
    txt(draw, mx, hero_y + 98, label, f_card_label, MID)

# Proportional accent bar at bottom — 70% green, 30% faint
bar_70 = int(CW * 0.70)
draw.rectangle((ML + 1, hero_y + hero_h - 4, ML + bar_70, hero_y + hero_h - 1), fill=GREEN)
draw.rectangle((ML + bar_70 + 3, hero_y + hero_h - 4, W - MR - 1, hero_y + hero_h - 1), fill=NEAR_FAINT)

y = hero_y + hero_h + 32

# ========================================
# TABLE: TOP 20 TRENDING REPOS
# ========================================
txt(draw, ML, y, "TOP 20 TRENDING REPOSITORIES", f_section, WHITE)
y += 40

# Inline legend
lx = ML
draw.ellipse((lx, y + 5, lx + 10, y + 15), fill=GREEN)
txt(draw, lx + 16, y, "AI / Agent Related", f_section_sub, LIGHT)
lx += 175
draw.ellipse((lx, y + 5, lx + 10, y + 15), fill=DIM)
txt(draw, lx + 16, y, "Other", f_section_sub, DIM)
lx += 78
txt(draw, lx, y, "·  Past 24 Hours  ·  Composite Score Ranking", f_section_sub, DIM)
y += 30

hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)
y += 10

# Column positions
c_rank  = ML + 10
c_repo  = ML + 68
c_lang  = ML + 745
c_stars = ML + 955
c_forks = ML + 1150
c_push  = ML + 1330
c_prs   = ML + 1490

# Table header
for cx, ht in [(c_rank,"#"),(c_repo,"REPOSITORY"),(c_lang,"LANG"),
               (c_stars,"★ STARS"),(c_forks,"FORKS"),(c_push,"PUSH"),(c_prs,"PRs")]:
    txt(draw, cx, y, ht, f_thead, DIM)
y += 26
hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, FAINT, 1)
y += 5

# Table rows
ROW_H = 56
for rank, repo, lang, stars, forks, pushes, prs, is_ai in repos:
    ry = y

    # Alternating background
    if rank % 2 == 0:
        draw.rectangle((ML, ry - 2, W - MR, ry + ROW_H - 8), fill=ROW_ALT)

    # Left accent bar
    ac = GREEN if is_ai else NEAR_FAINT
    draw.rectangle((ML, ry + 3, ML + 3, ry + ROW_H - 9), fill=ac)

    # Rank
    if rank <= 3:
        top_c = [AMBER, LIGHT, CYAN][rank - 1]
        txt(draw, c_rank, ry + 2, f"#{rank}", f_rank_top, top_c)
    else:
        txt(draw, c_rank, ry + 3, f"#{rank}", f_rank, MID if is_ai else DIM)

    # Repo name — smart truncation
    repo_d = repo
    if len(repo) > 38:
        parts = repo.split("/")
        if len(parts) == 2:
            owner, name = parts
            if len(owner) > 14:
                owner = owner[:13] + "…"
            repo_d = f"{owner}/{name}"
            if len(repo_d) > 38:
                repo_d = repo_d[:37] + "…"

    rf = f_trepo_b if is_ai else f_trepo
    rc = WHITE if is_ai else (98, 108, 135)
    txt(draw, c_repo, ry + 3, repo_d, rf, rc)

    # Language
    lc = LANG_COLORS.get(lang, DIM)
    if not is_ai and lang != "—":
        r, g, b = lc
        lc = (max(38, r//2+32), max(38, g//2+32), max(38, b//2+32))
    txt(draw, c_lang, ry + 3, lang, f_tdata, lc)

    # Stars
    txt(draw, c_stars, ry + 3, f"{stars:,}", f_tdata, WHITE if is_ai else (105, 115, 140))

    # Forks
    txt(draw, c_forks, ry + 3, f"{forks:,}", f_tdata, LIGHT if is_ai else DIM)

    # Pushes
    pc = GREEN if pushes > 10 else (LIGHT if is_ai and pushes > 0 else DIM)
    txt(draw, c_push, ry + 3, str(pushes), f_tdata, pc)

    # PRs
    prc = CYAN if prs > 5 else (LIGHT if is_ai and prs > 0 else DIM)
    txt(draw, c_prs, ry + 3, str(prs), f_tdata, prc)

    y += ROW_H

# Close table
hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)
y += 32

# ========================================
# BOTTOM: Two-column layout
# ========================================
half_w = (CW - 50) // 2
right_x = ML + half_w + 50

# ---- LEFT COLUMN ----
ly = y
txt(draw, ML, ly, "LANGUAGE DISTRIBUTION", f_section, WHITE)
ly += 42

bar_max = half_w - 190
for lang_name, count, pct, color in lang_data:
    bw = int(bar_max * (pct / 100.0))

    txt(draw, ML, ly + 1, lang_name, f_bar_label, LIGHT)

    bx = ML + 120
    rrect(draw, (bx, ly + 2, bx + bar_max, ly + 24), 4, (18, 24, 44))
    if bw > 8:
        rrect(draw, (bx, ly + 2, bx + bw, ly + 24), 4, color)

    txt(draw, bx + bar_max + 12, ly + 1, f"{count} repos · {pct}%", f_bar_val, MID)
    ly += 38

ly += 14

# AI vs Non-AI bar
txt(draw, ML, ly, "CATEGORY SPLIT", f_section, WHITE)
ly += 40

ai_px = int(half_w * 0.70)
non_px = half_w - ai_px - 5

rrect(draw, (ML, ly, ML + ai_px, ly + 32), 4, (0, 50, 35))
draw.rectangle((ML, ly, ML + ai_px, ly + 2), fill=GREEN)
txt(draw, ML + 12, ly + 5, "AI / Agent  ·  14 repos  ·  70%", f_small, GREEN)

rrect(draw, (ML + ai_px + 5, ly, ML + half_w, ly + 32), 4, (24, 28, 42))
txt(draw, ML + ai_px + 17, ly + 5, "Other  ·  6 repos", f_small, DIM)

ly += 48

# Stat pills
pills = [
    ("3,254", "Stars Across Top 10", AMBER),
    ("7", "Python Repos (Most)", CYAN),
]
px = ML
for val, label, color in pills:
    pw = 200
    rrect(draw, (px, ly, px + pw, ly + 40), 5, CARD_BG)
    draw.rectangle((px, ly, px + pw, ly + 2), fill=color)
    txt(draw, px + 10, ly + 5, val, f_pill_val, WHITE)
    txt(draw, px + 10, ly + 24, label, f_pill_label, MID)
    px += pw + 14

# ---- RIGHT COLUMN ----
ry = y
txt(draw, right_x, ry, "KEY THEMES", f_section, WHITE)
ry += 42

for title, body, color in themes:
    draw.rectangle((right_x, ry + 5, right_x + 3, ry + 17), fill=color)
    draw.ellipse((right_x + 8, ry + 7, right_x + 17, ry + 16), fill=color)

    txt(draw, right_x + 24, ry, title, f_theme_title, color)
    txt(draw, right_x + 24, ry + 26, body, f_theme_body, MID)
    ry += 58

ry += 12
hrule(draw, ry, right_x, W - MR, FAINT, 1)
ry += 16

synth = [
    ("The open-source community is racing to build", LIGHT),
    ("infrastructure for AI-augmented development.", LIGHT),
    ("Agent autonomy & efficiency are the twin priorities.", CYAN),
]
for text, color in synth:
    txt(draw, right_x, ry, text, f_theme_body, color)
    ry += 24

# ========================================
# REFERENCE MARKS — Scientific instrument precision
# ========================================
# Corner marks — measurement frame
cm = 16
# Top-right
draw.line([(W - MR, 85), (W - MR, 85 + cm)], fill=TICK, width=1)
draw.line([(W - MR - cm, 85), (W - MR, 85)], fill=TICK, width=1)
# Bottom-left
draw.line([(ML, H - 55 - cm), (ML, H - 55)], fill=TICK, width=1)
draw.line([(ML, H - 55), (ML + cm, H - 55)], fill=TICK, width=1)

# Side reference ticks — coordinate markers
for ty in [500, 1100, 1900]:
    draw.line([(ML - 6, ty), (ML - 1, ty)], fill=TICK, width=1)
    draw.line([(W - MR + 1, ty), (W - MR + 6, ty)], fill=TICK, width=1)

# Tiny section reference codes — imaginary discipline markers
txt(draw, W - MR, hero_y + hero_h + 8, "§02", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")
txt(draw, W - MR, y - 22, "§03", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")

# Left margin section codes
txt(draw, ML - 5, hero_y + 10, "01", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")
txt(draw, ML - 5, y + 2, "02", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")
txt(draw, ML - 5, ly - 200, "03", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")

# ========================================
# FOOTER
# ========================================
fy = H - 55
hrule(draw, fy, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 1)
fy += 12
txt(draw, ML, fy, "Source: OSSInsight  ·  Data: Past 24 Hours  ·  Method: Stars Score + Forks Score + Base Score", f_tiny, DIM)
txt(draw, W - MR, fy, "SIGNAL NOIR", lf("Tektur-Medium.ttf", 13), NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")

# ========================================
# SAVE
# ========================================
img.save(OUTPUT_PATH, "PNG", dpi=(300, 300))
print(f"Poster saved to {OUTPUT_PATH}")
print(f"Dimensions: {W}x{H}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Signal Noir — GitHub's Hottest Repos: AI Agents Dominate
FINAL MUSEUM PASS — Every element painstakingly calibrated.

"A diagram from an imaginary discipline, treating the invisible subject
with the same reverence typically reserved for documenting observable phenomena."
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os
import math

# === PATHS ===
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# === CANVAS ===
W, H = 2400, 3400
BG_BASE = (8, 11, 22)

# === SIGNAL NOIR PALETTE — final calibrated ===
CYAN        = (0, 195, 255)
CYAN_BRIGHT = (80, 220, 255)
GREEN       = (0, 235, 125)
GREEN_DEEP  = (0, 140, 80)
GREEN_GLOW  = (0, 60, 35)
AMBER       = (255, 175, 65)
WHITE       = (248, 250, 255)
LIGHT       = (192, 204, 228)
MID         = (125, 140, 170)
DIM         = (70, 82, 108)
FAINT       = (35, 46, 70)
NEAR_FAINT  = (24, 34, 54)
TICK        = (42, 55, 82)

CARD_BG     = (11, 17, 32)
ROW_ALT     = (10, 14, 27)
RULE_COLOR  = (28, 40, 65)
DEEP_RULE   = (20, 30, 50)

LANG_COLORS = {
    "Python":     (0, 195, 255),
    "TypeScript": (55, 135, 255),
    "Rust":       (255, 175, 65),
    "JavaScript": (222, 202, 62),
    "Dart":       (72, 190, 250),
    "HTML":       (212, 92, 72),
    "Verilog":    (160, 120, 245),
    "Shell":      (120, 180, 82),
    "—":          (70, 82, 108),
}

# === FONTS ===
def lf(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

f_title       = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 94)
f_subtitle    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_method      = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_section     = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_section_sub = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_huge_pct    = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 152)
f_pct_label   = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_card_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 48)
f_card_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_thead       = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 19)
f_tdata       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_trepo       = lf("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_trepo_b     = lf("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_rank        = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_rank_top    = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_bar_label   = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_bar_val     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_theme_title = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_theme_body  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_small       = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_tiny        = lf("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_pill_val    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_pill_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_ref         = lf("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 13)

# === DATA ===
repos = [
    (1,  "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills","—",         826, 79,  0,  0,  True),
    (2,  "NousResearch/hermes-agent",          "Python",    468, 102, 66, 61, True),
    (3,  "NawfalMotii79/PLFM_RADAR",           "Verilog",   353, 81,  5,  0,  False),
    (4,  "thedotmack/claude-mem",              "TypeScript",335, 33,  4,  0,  True),
    (5,  "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",        "HTML",      321, 49,  0,  0,  True),

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Signal Noir — GitHub's Hottest Repos: AI Agents Dominate
FINAL MUSEUM PASS — Meticulous calibration. Every pixel earns its place.

No global darkening. No wasted space. Every signal precisely placed.
The product of painstaking attention and master-level execution.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os
import math

# === PATHS ===
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# === CANVAS ===
W, H = 2400, 3400
BG_BASE = (8, 11, 22)

# === SIGNAL NOIR PALETTE — final calibrated ===
CYAN        = (0, 195, 255)
CYAN_BRIGHT = (80, 220, 255)
GREEN       = (0, 235, 125)
GREEN_DEEP  = (0, 140, 80)
AMBER       = (255, 175, 65)
WHITE       = (248, 250, 255)
LIGHT       = (192, 204, 228)
MID         = (125, 140, 170)
DIM         = (70, 82, 108)
FAINT       = (35, 46, 70)
NEAR_FAINT  = (24, 34, 54)
TICK        = (42, 55, 82)

CARD_BG     = (11, 17, 32)
ROW_ALT     = (10, 14, 27)
RULE_COLOR  = (28, 40, 65)
DEEP_RULE   = (20, 30, 50)

LANG_COLORS = {
    "Python":     (0, 195, 255),
    "TypeScript": (55, 135, 255),
    "Rust":       (255, 175, 65),
    "JavaScript": (222, 202, 62),
    "Dart":       (72, 190, 250),
    "HTML":       (212, 92, 72),
    "Verilog":    (160, 120, 245),
    "Shell":      (120, 180, 82),
    "—":          (70, 82, 108),
}

# === FONTS ===
def lf(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

f_title       = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 94)
f_subtitle    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_method      = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_section     = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_section_sub = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_huge_pct    = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 152)
f_pct_label   = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_card_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 48)
f_card_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_thead       = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 19)
f_tdata       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_trepo       = lf("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_trepo_b     = lf("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_rank        = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_rank_top    = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_bar_label   = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_bar_val     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_theme_title = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_theme_body  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_small       = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_tiny        = lf("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_pill_val    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_pill_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_ref         = lf("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 13)

# === DATA ===
repos = [
    (1,  "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills","—",         826, 79,  0,  0,  True),
    (2,  "NousResearch/hermes-agent",          "Python",    468, 102, 66, 61, True),
    (3,  "NawfalMotii79/PLFM_RADAR",           "Verilog",   353, 81,  5,  0,  False),
    (4,  "thedotmack/claude-mem",              "TypeScript",335, 33,  4,  0,  True),
    (5,  "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",        "HTML",      321, 49,  0,  0,  True),
    (6,  "JuliusBrussee/caveman",              "Python",    237, 19,  0,  3,  True),
    (7,  "multica-ai/multica",                 "TypeScript",139, 13, 44, 10, True),
    (8,  "safishamsi/graphify",                "Python",    120, 13,  0,  1,  True),
    (9,  "jamiepine/voicebox",                 "TypeScript",100, 12,  8,  3,  True),
    (10, "lsdefine/GenericAgent",              "Python",    101, 9,   5,  2,  True),
    (11, "rohitg00/ai-eng-from-scratch",       "Python",    82,  19,  0,  0,  True),
    (12, "EvoMap/evolver",                     "JavaScript",95,  5,   1,  1,  False),
    (13, "google/magika",                      "Python",    122, 7,   0,  3,  True),
    (14, "vercel-labs/open-agents",            "TypeScript",84,  12,  2,  12, True),
    (15, "thunderbird/thunderbolt",            "TypeScript",82,  4,   7,  0,  False),
    (16, "alchaincyf/nuwa-skill",              "Python",    67,  17,  0,  0,  True),
    (17, "BasedHardware/omi",                  "Dart",      111, 72,  9,  7,  False),
    (18, "farion1231/cc-switch",               "Rust",      77,  6,   5,  0,  False),
    (19, "S.Avogadro/android-re-skill",        "Shell",     77,  0,   0,  0,  False),
    (20, "rtk-ai/rtk",                         "Rust",      73,  4,   2,  1,  True),
]

lang_data = [
    ("Python",     7, 35, CYAN),
    ("TypeScript",  5, 25, (55, 135, 255)),
    ("Rust",        2, 10, AMBER),
    ("Others",      6, 30, DIM),
]

themes = [
    ("Autonomous Coding Agents", "AI writes code, handles issues, executes tasks", CYAN),
    ("Token Optimization",       "Slashing LLM token consumption by 60–90%", AMBER),
    ("Memory & Context Mgmt",    "Capturing, compressing, injecting session context", GREEN),
    ("Skill Distillation",       "Packaging expert mental models as reusable AI skills", CYAN_BRIGHT),
]

# === HELPERS ===
def txt(d, x, y, text, font, fill, anchor="la"):
    d.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def hrule(d, y, x0, x1, color=RULE_COLOR, width=1):
    d.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rrect(d, bbox, r, fill, outline=None, width=1):
    d.rounded_rectangle(bbox, radius=r, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

# ========================================
# ATMOSPHERIC BACKGROUND — Localized glows only
# No global blending that darkens content
# ========================================
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_BASE)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Top-center atmosphere — drawn directly as faint ellipses
# This approach adds light instead of darkening
for r in range(600, 0, -6):
    v = max(0, min(3, int(3 * (1 - r / 600))))
    c = (8 + v, 11 + v * 2, 22 + v * 4)
    draw.ellipse([W//2 - r, 60 - r//3, W//2 + r, 60 + r//3], fill=c)

# ========================================
# LAYOUT
# ========================================
ML = 115
MR = 115
CW = W - ML - MR
y = 0

# ========================================
# HEADER
# ========================================
y = 95

# Signal markers — three precise dashes
draw.line([(ML, y), (ML + 88, y)], fill=CYAN, width=2)
draw.line([(ML + 98, y), (ML + 136, y)], fill=GREEN, width=2)
draw.line([(ML + 146, y), (ML + 166, y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)

# Reference label
txt(draw, W - MR, y + 2, "REF.OSS-TREND-2024", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")
y += 28

# Title
txt(draw, ML, y, "GITHUB'S HOTTEST REPOS", f_title, WHITE)
y += 108

# Subtitle
txt(draw, ML, y, "AI Agents Dominate the Trending Charts", f_subtitle, CYAN)
y += 40

# Method line
m_parts = ["OSSInsight", "10.6B+ Events Tracked", "Score = Stars + Forks + Base"]
mpx = ML
for i, part in enumerate(m_parts):
    txt(draw, mpx, y, part, f_method, LIGHT if i == 0 else MID)
    mpx += int(draw.textlength(part, font=f_method))
    if i < len(m_parts) - 1:
        txt(draw, mpx + 8, y, "·", f_method, DIM)
        mpx += int(draw.textlength("·", font=f_method)) + 16
y += 32

# Signature rule
hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)
draw.rectangle((ML, y - 1, ML + 52, y + 1), fill=CYAN)
draw.rectangle((ML + 57, y - 1, ML + 100, y + 1), fill=GREEN)
y += 28

# ========================================
# HERO: 70% — The Headline Signal
# ========================================
hero_h = 195
hero_y = y

# Card background
rrect(draw, (ML, hero_y, W - MR, hero_y + hero_h), 10, CARD_BG)

# Subtle inner border
rrect(draw, (ML + 1, hero_y + 1, W - MR - 1, hero_y + hero_h - 1), 10, None, NEAR_FAINT, 1)

# LUMINOUS GLOW — drawn directly into the hero card area only
# Green glow emanating from behind the 70% text
glow_cx = ML + 150
glow_cy = hero_y + 95
for r in range(220, 0, -3):
    v = max(0, min(8, int(8 * (1 - r / 220))))
    c = (11 + v // 2, 17 + v * 2, 32 + v)
    # Only draw within the hero card bounds
    x0 = max(ML + 2, glow_cx - r)
    y0 = max(hero_y + 2, glow_cy - r // 2)
    x1 = min(W - MR - 2, glow_cx + r)
    y1 = min(hero_y + hero_h - 2, glow_cy + r // 2)
    if x1 > x0 and y1 > y0:
        draw.ellipse([x0, y0, x1, y1], fill=c)

# The percentage — monumental
txt(draw, ML + 50, hero_y + 6, "70%", f_huge_pct, GREEN)

# Label beneath
txt(draw, ML + 50, hero_y + 165, "of trending repos are AI/agent-related", f_pct_label, LIGHT)

# Vertical divider
div_x = ML + 530
draw.line([(div_x, hero_y + 24), (div_x, hero_y + hero_h - 24)], fill=FAINT, width=1)

# Right supporting metrics
rm_x = div_x + 36
rm_gap = 24
rm_w = (W - MR - rm_x - 10) // 3

right_metrics = [
    ("14/20", "AI Repos in Top 20", GREEN),
    ("10.6B+", "Events Tracked", CYAN),
    ("826", "Top Stars (24h)", AMBER),
]

for i, (val, label, color) in enumerate(right_metrics):
    mx = rm_x + i * (rm_w + rm_gap)
    draw.rectangle((mx, hero_y + 28, mx + 26, hero_y + 31), fill=color)
    txt(draw, mx, hero_y + 42, val, f_card_num, WHITE)
    txt(draw, mx, hero_y + 98, label, f_card_label, MID)

# Proportional accent bar
bar_70 = int(CW * 0.70)
draw.rectangle((ML + 1, hero_y + hero_h - 4, ML + bar_70, hero_y + hero_h - 1), fill=GREEN)
draw.rectangle((ML + bar_70 + 3, hero_y + hero_h - 4, W - MR - 1, hero_y + hero_h - 1), fill=NEAR_FAINT)

y = hero_y + hero_h + 32

# ========================================
# TABLE: TOP 20 TRENDING REPOS
# ========================================
txt(draw, ML, y, "TOP 20 TRENDING REPOSITORIES", f_section, WHITE)
y += 40

# Inline legend
lx = ML
draw.ellipse((lx, y + 5, lx + 10, y + 15), fill=GREEN)
txt(draw, lx + 16, y, "AI / Agent Related", f_section_sub, LIGHT)
lx += 175
draw.ellipse((lx, y + 5, lx + 10, y + 15), fill=DIM)
txt(draw, lx + 16, y, "Other", f_section_sub, DIM)
lx += 78
txt(draw, lx, y, "·  Past 24 Hours  ·  Composite Score Ranking", f_section_sub, DIM)
y += 30

hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)
y += 10

# Column positions
c_rank  = ML + 10
c_repo  = ML + 68
c_lang  = ML + 745
c_stars = ML + 955
c_forks = ML + 1150
c_push  = ML + 1330
c_prs   = ML + 1490

# Table header
for cx, ht in [(c_rank,"#"),(c_repo,"REPOSITORY"),(c_lang,"LANG"),
               (c_stars,"★ STARS"),(c_forks,"FORKS"),(c_push,"PUSH"),(c_prs,"PRs")]:
    txt(draw, cx, y, ht, f_thead, DIM)
y += 26
hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, FAINT, 1)
y += 5

# Table rows
ROW_H = 56
for rank, repo, lang, stars, forks, pushes, prs, is_ai in repos:
    ry = y

    if rank % 2 == 0:
        draw.rectangle((ML, ry - 2, W - MR, ry + ROW_H - 8), fill=ROW_ALT)

    ac = GREEN if is_ai else NEAR_FAINT
    draw.rectangle((ML, ry + 3, ML + 3, ry + ROW_H - 9), fill=ac)

    if rank <= 3:
        top_c = [AMBER, LIGHT, CYAN][rank - 1]
        txt(draw, c_rank, ry + 2, f"#{rank}", f_rank_top, top_c)
    else:
        txt(draw, c_rank, ry + 3, f"#{rank}", f_rank, MID if is_ai else DIM)

    repo_d = repo
    if len(repo) > 38:
        parts = repo.split("/")
        if len(parts) == 2:
            owner, name = parts
            if len(owner) > 14:
                owner = owner[:13] + "…"
            repo_d = f"{owner}/{name}"
            if len(repo_d) > 38:
                repo_d = repo_d[:37] + "…"

    rf = f_trepo_b if is_ai else f_trepo
    rc = WHITE if is_ai else (98, 108, 135)
    txt(draw, c_repo, ry + 3, repo_d, rf, rc)

    lc = LANG_COLORS.get(lang, DIM)
    if not is_ai and lang != "—":
        r, g, b = lc
        lc = (max(38, r//2+32), max(38, g//2+32), max(38, b//2+32))
    txt(draw, c_lang, ry + 3, lang, f_tdata, lc)

    txt(draw, c_stars, ry + 3, f"{stars:,}", f_tdata, WHITE if is_ai else (105, 115, 140))
    txt(draw, c_forks, ry + 3, f"{forks:,}", f_tdata, LIGHT if is_ai else DIM)

    pc = GREEN if pushes > 10 else (LIGHT if is_ai and pushes > 0 else DIM)
    txt(draw, c_push, ry + 3, str(pushes), f_tdata, pc)

    prc = CYAN if prs > 5 else (LIGHT if is_ai and prs > 0 else DIM)
    txt(draw, c_prs, ry + 3, str(prs), f_tdata, prc)

    y += ROW_H

hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)
y += 32

# ========================================
# BOTTOM: Two-column layout
# ========================================
half_w = (CW - 50) // 2
right_x = ML + half_w + 50

# ---- LEFT COLUMN ----
ly = y
txt(draw, ML, ly, "LANGUAGE DISTRIBUTION", f_section, WHITE)
ly += 42

bar_max = half_w - 190
for lang_name, count, pct, color in lang_data:
    bw = int(bar_max * (pct / 100.0))
    txt(draw, ML, ly + 1, lang_name, f_bar_label, LIGHT)
    bx = ML + 120
    rrect(draw, (bx, ly + 2, bx + bar_max, ly + 24), 4, (18, 24, 44))
    if bw > 8:
        rrect(draw, (bx, ly + 2, bx + bw, ly + 24), 4, color)
    txt(draw, bx + bar_max + 12, ly + 1, f"{count} repos · {pct}%", f_bar_val, MID)
    ly += 38

ly += 14

# AI vs Non-AI bar
txt(draw, ML, ly, "CATEGORY SPLIT", f_section, WHITE)
ly += 40

ai_px = int(half_w * 0.70)
rrect(draw, (ML, ly, ML + ai_px, ly + 32), 4, (0, 50, 35))
draw.rectangle((ML, ly, ML + ai_px, ly + 2), fill=GREEN)
txt(draw, ML + 12, ly + 5, "AI / Agent  ·  14 repos  ·  70%", f_small, GREEN)

rrect(draw, (ML + ai_px + 5, ly, ML + half_w, ly + 32), 4, (24, 28, 42))
txt(draw, ML + ai_px + 17, ly + 5, "Other  ·  6 repos", f_small, DIM)
ly += 48

# Stat pills
pills = [
    ("3,254", "Stars Across Top 10", AMBER),
    ("7", "Python Repos (Most)", CYAN),
]
px = ML
for val, label, color in pills:
    pw = 200
    rrect(draw, (px, ly, px + pw, ly + 40), 5, CARD_BG)
    draw.rectangle((px, ly, px + pw, ly + 2), fill=color)
    txt(draw, px + 10, ly + 5, val, f_pill_val, WHITE)
    txt(draw, px + 10, ly + 24, label, f_pill_label, MID)
    px += pw + 14

# ---- RIGHT COLUMN ----
ry = y
txt(draw, right_x, ry, "KEY THEMES", f_section, WHITE)
ry += 42

for title, body, color in themes:
    draw.rectangle((right_x, ry + 5, right_x + 3, ry + 17), fill=color)
    draw.ellipse((right_x + 8, ry + 7, right_x + 17, ry + 16), fill=color)
    txt(draw, right_x + 24, ry, title, f_theme_title, color)
    txt(draw, right_x + 24, ry + 26, body, f_theme_body, MID)
    ry += 58

ry += 12
hrule(draw, ry, right_x, W - MR, FAINT, 1)
ry += 16

    ("The open-source community is racing to build", LIGHT),
    ("infrastructure for AI-augmented development.", LIGHT),
    ("Agent autonomy & efficiency are the twin priorities.", CYAN),
]
for text, color in synth:
    txt(draw, right_x, ry, text, f_theme_body, color)
    ry += 24

# REFERENCE MARKS — Scientific instrument precision

draw.line([(W - MR - cm, 85), (W - MR, 85)], fill=TICK, width=1)
draw.line([(ML, H - 55 - cm), (ML, H - 55)], fill=TICK, width=1)
draw.line([(ML, H - 55), (ML + cm, H - 55)], fill=TICK, width=1)

for ty in [500, 1100, 1900]:
    draw.line([(ML - 6, ty), (ML - 1, ty)], fill=TICK, width=1)
    draw.line([(W - MR + 1, ty), (W - MR + 6, ty)], fill=TICK, width=1)

txt(draw, W - MR, hero_y + hero_h + 8, "§02", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")

txt(draw, ML - 5, hero_y + 10, "01", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")
txt(draw, ML - 5, y + 2, "02", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")
txt(draw, ML - 5, ly - 200, "03", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")

# FOOTER

"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os
import math

# === PATHS ===

# === CANVAS ===

    "Python":     (0, 195, 255),

}

# === FONTS ===
def lf(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

f_title       = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 94)

f_tiny        = lf("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_pill_val    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_pill_label  = lf("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_ref         = lf("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 13)

# === DATA ===
repos = [
    (1,  "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills","—",         826, 79,  0,  0,  True),
    (2,  "NousResearch/hermes-agent",          "Python",    468, 102, 66, 61, True),

]

# === HELPERS ===
def txt(d, x, y, text, font, fill, anchor="la"):

    d.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

# ========================================

draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

for r in range(600, 0, -6):

    draw.ellipse([W//2 - r, 60 - r//3, W//2 + r, 60 + r//3], fill=c)

# ========================================
# LAYOUT

ML = 115
MR = 115
CW = W - ML - MR
y = 0

# ========================================

# Signal markers — three precise dashes

draw.line([(ML + 146, y), (ML + 166, y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)

# Reference label
txt(draw, W - MR, y + 2, "REF.OSS-TREND-2024", f_ref, NEAR_FAINT, anchor="ra")
y += 28

# Title
txt(draw, ML, y, "GITHUB'S HOTTEST REPOS", f_title, WHITE)
y += 108

# Subtitle
txt(draw, ML, y, "AI Agents Dominate the Trending Charts", f_subtitle, CYAN)
y += 40

# Method line
m_parts = ["OSSInsight", "10.6B+ Events Tracked", "Score = Stars + Forks + Base"]
mpx = ML
for i, part in enumerate(m_parts):
    txt(draw, mpx, y, part, f_method, LIGHT if i == 0 else MID)
    mpx += int(draw.textlength(part, font=f_method))
    if i < len(m_parts) - 1:

y += 32

# Signature rule
hrule(draw, y, ML, W - MR, DEEP_RULE, 2)

for r in range(220, 0, -3):

# Label beneath
txt(draw, ML + 50, hero_y + 165, "of trending repos are AI/agent-related", f_pct_label, LIGHT)

# Vertical divider

# Right supporting metrics

y = hero_y + hero_h + 32
